composition.serve_who: Sheet 21 of 27 (SWS_108-1_AFT PLC.dwg, section AFT) documents three 2-channel digital-output modules (750-508) at PLC positions 13,14,15 in the AFT rack, each channel driving one hydraulic directional-valve solenoid coil named on the sheet. The functions serve three named pieces of equipment: transom door (EV 10.1A/B), deck door (EV 10.2A/B), and mainsheet traveller (EV 10.3A/B). Per the engineer-confirmed mapping, transom door -> 260-transom-door, deck door -> 260-deck-door, mainsheet traveller -> 840-cariboni-hydraulic-cylinders. The rack layout/module inventory itself (positions 13-15, CPU 750-8213, coupler) is infrastructure of the AFT PLC I/O rack, node 570-plc-rack-aft, per the RACK/INDEX rule; the pilot valve type for each EV-x.y is established on the hydraulic sheets (PVEO/PVEU) and must be kept, not downgraded to 'solenoid'.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet labels 'transom door CLOSE (EV 10.1A)' and 'transom door OPEN (EV 10.1B)' driven by DO-03 CH01/CH02 on the POS.13 module; engineer mapping ties 'transom door' directly to node 260-transom-door.

functions.label: Transom door CLOSE actuation
functions.sheet_region: top-left module block (POS.13), left channel, connector pins 1/2
functions.what_it_does: Energising this PLC output drives the CLOSE-side pilot valve of the transom door hydraulic cylinder, closing the door.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-03 CH01 output = 0V -> no drive current to EV 10.1A pilot -> door hydraulic circuit holds last position (no motion).

PLC digital output DO-03 CH01 (module POS.13, 750-508) energises -> switched conductor to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 1 -> continues off-sheet (see sheet 4) to EV 10.1A pilot valve coil on the transom door hydraulic manifold -> pilot shifts spool to CLOSE flow path -> transom door cylinder retracts/closes; return conductor from module's '-' field terminal to connector pin 2 completes the loop, measured relative to the module's own '-' (common) terminal for that channel.

key_components: pilot valve coil EV 10.1A (type per hydraulic sheet: PVEO/PVEU, not downgraded to bare solenoid)
functions.dry_data: Module 750-508 (2DO), CPU 750-8213, rack position 13; channel DO-03 CH01; digital on/off output; voltage measured relative to module common '-' terminal (A2/'-' field terminal for that channel pair).

functions.label: Transom door OPEN actuation
functions.sheet_region: top-left module block (POS.13), right channel, connector pins 4/3
functions.what_it_does: Energising this PLC output drives the OPEN-side pilot valve of the transom door hydraulic cylinder, opening the door.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-03 CH02 output = 0V -> no drive to EV 10.1B pilot -> no motion commanded on OPEN side.

PLC digital output DO-03 CH02 (module POS.13) energises -> switched conductor to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 4 -> continues off-sheet (see sheet 4) to EV 10.1B pilot valve coil -> pilot shifts spool to OPEN flow path -> transom door cylinder extends/opens; return conductor to connector pin 3, voltage measured relative to module's '-' common terminal.

functions.dry_data: Module 750-508 (2DO), CPU 750-8213, rack position 13; channel DO-03 CH02; digital on/off output; common reference = module '-' terminal.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet labels 'deck door OPEN (EV 10.2A)' and 'deck door CLOSE (EV 10.2B)' driven by DO-04 CH01/CH02 on the POS.14 module; engineer mapping ties 'deck door' to node 260-deck-door.

functions.label: Deck door OPEN actuation
functions.sheet_region: middle module block (POS.14), left channel, connector pins 1/2
functions.what_it_does: Energising this PLC output drives the OPEN-side pilot valve of the deck door hydraulic cylinder, opening the door.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-04 CH01 output = 0V -> no drive to EV 10.2A pilot -> no motion commanded.

PLC digital output DO-04 CH01 (module POS.14) energises -> switched conductor to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 1 -> continues off-sheet (see sheet 4) to EV 10.2A pilot valve coil -> pilot shifts spool to OPEN flow path -> deck door cylinder opens the door; return conductor to connector pin 2, voltage measured relative to the module's '-' common terminal.

functions.dry_data: Module 750-508 (2DO), CPU 750-8213, rack position 14; channel DO-04 CH01; digital on/off output; common reference = module '-' terminal.

functions.label: Deck door CLOSE actuation
functions.sheet_region: middle module block (POS.14), right channel, connector pins 4/3
functions.what_it_does: Energising this PLC output drives the CLOSE-side pilot valve of the deck door hydraulic cylinder, closing the door.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-04 CH02 output = 0V -> no drive to EV 10.2B pilot -> no motion commanded.

PLC digital output DO-04 CH02 (module POS.14) energises -> switched conductor to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 4 -> continues off-sheet (see sheet 4) to EV 10.2B pilot valve coil -> pilot shifts spool to CLOSE flow path -> deck door cylinder closes the door; return conductor to connector pin 3, voltage measured relative to module's '-' common terminal.

functions.dry_data: Module 750-508 (2DO), CPU 750-8213, rack position 14; channel DO-04 CH02; digital on/off output; common reference = module '-' terminal.

equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Sheet labels 'mainsheet traveler TO PORT (EV 10.3A)' and 'mainsheet traveler TO STBD (EV 10.3B)' driven by DO-05 CH01/CH02 on the POS.15 module; engineer mapping routes 'mainsheet traveller' function to the shared Cariboni hydraulic cylinders node.

functions.label: Mainsheet traveller shift TO PORT
functions.sheet_region: right module block (POS.15), left channel, connector pins 1/2
functions.what_it_does: Energising this PLC output drives the TO-PORT pilot valve of the mainsheet traveller hydraulic cylinder, shifting the traveller car to port.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-05 CH01 output = 0V -> no drive to EV 10.3A pilot -> traveller holds position.

PLC digital output DO-05 CH01 (module POS.15) energises -> switched conductor to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 1 -> continues off-sheet (see sheet 4) to EV 10.3A pilot valve coil on the traveller manifold -> pilot shifts spool to feed the port-side cylinder chamber -> mainsheet traveller car moves to port; return conductor to connector pin 2, voltage measured relative to module's '-' common terminal.

functions.sheet_region: right module block (POS.15), right channel, connector pins 4/3
functions.what_it_does: Energising this PLC output drives the TO-STBD pilot valve of the mainsheet traveller hydraulic cylinder, shifting the traveller car to starboard.

flow_scenarios.path: DO-05 CH02 output = 0V -> no drive to EV 10.3B pilot -> traveller holds position.

PLC digital output DO-05 CH02 (module POS.15) energises -> switched conductor to CONNECTOR TYPE I pin 4 -> continues off-sheet (see sheet 4) to EV 10.3B pilot valve coil -> pilot shifts spool to feed the starboard-side cylinder chamber -> mainsheet traveller car moves to starboard; return conductor to connector pin 3, voltage measured relative to module's '-' common terminal.

infrastructure.system_name: AFT PLC I/O Rack (WAGO) — DO module inventory positions 13-15
facts: Rack inventory continues with three 2-channel digital-output modules: 750-508 at position 13 (DO-03), position 14 (DO-04), position 15 (DO-05), all sharing CPU 750-8213.

Each module has two channels with dedicated +/- field-power terminal pairs per channel and an A1/A2 marking above the channel pair; no on-sheet upstream branch protective device (breaker/fuse) or supply rating is shown for the field power feeding these modules.
Each channel's switched output and paired return route to a 4-pin CONNECTOR TYPE I (pins 1/2 for CH01, pins 4/3 for CH02); the connector's downstream continuation is documented on sheet 4.
This is page 21 of 27 in the AFT PLC rack index/detail series (SWS_108-1_AFT PLC.dwg); it is a module-detail page following the rack GA/index page, per the RACK/INDEX convention.
No local switch, interposing relay, contactor, or monitoring/alarm tap is drawn on this sheet; the only control points shown are the PLC digital outputs themselves.

uncertainties: No upstream branch protective device (breaker/fuse), incoming supply identifier, or voltage rating for the field power feeding the three 750-508 modules is shown on this sheet — cannot be determined from sheet 21 alone.

The exact common/reference terminal designation (whether module has a distinct 'M' common rail vs. per-channel '-' terminal only) is not explicitly labelled beyond '+'/'-' pairs per channel; assumed per-channel '-' terminal serves as the local reference since no separate 'M' terminal is shown on this module type.
